screen.custom_rule: lowest fixed-document equal-category macro BPB; tie by lower active seconds, then smaller vocabulary, then ID

confirmation.runs: baseline and selected custom at all three seeds; seed-42 screen runs are reused

stopping.fixed_flop_target: analytic FLOPs consumed by Mistral seed 42 at the fixed-document endpoint
stopping.quality_target: Mistral seed-42 fixed-document final macro BPB, defined before custom curves are inspected

statistics.macro_score: unweighted mean of six category means
statistics.paired_delta: candidate minus Mistral on identical document IDs and UTF-8 byte counts
statistics.seed_aggregation: average each document delta over confirmation seeds before bootstrap

ranking.primary: lower median analytic FLOPs to the frozen quality target

requires: pilot corpus exclusion pass and fixed document-stream manifest
tokenizer-specific packing with matched document IDs
exact optimizer schedule and seven run manifests
document-level two-view NLL output required by the frozen analyzer

supersedes.reason: bind completed formal static nomination and a conservative full-corpus near-dedup pass against every prepared firewall candidate without opening D5

pilot_corpus.strategy: put all twelve globally deduplicated prepared firewall candidate views before all six full calibration training sources, then rerun exact and verified-near deduplication
pilot_corpus.conservatism: the reference superset is larger than the final firewall and may remove extra eligible training documents; this is acceptable for a matched tokenizer pilot and prevents sealed-audit access
pilot_corpus.required_gate: six pilot_train outputs retain at least 1.2B Mistral reference tokens after all firewall-reference exact/near exclusions
